variants.headline: Engineered for Recovery and Peak Physical Performance
variants.body: Optimize your daily movement with activewear engineered to support your body's natural biomechanics. Crafted from recycled ocean plastic, this high-performance fabric offers precise compression and breathability to help you sustain energy and recover efficiently from every workout.
variants.rationale: This copy focuses on physical optimization, body mechanics, and biological recovery to appeal to her systems-based approach to wellness.

variants.headline: Premium Activewear Crafted Entirely From Recycled Ocean Plastic
variants.body: Turn ocean waste into your new favorite workout gear. Our premium activewear is made directly from diverted ocean plastics, offering a transparently sourced, high-durability alternative to traditional synthetic fabrics without compromising on conscious quality or construction.
variants.rationale: It highlights the specific, transparent source material of recycled ocean plastic and frames the product as a direct alternative to synthetic fast fashion.

variants.headline: Technical Activewear Built for High-Intensity Performance
variants.body: Push your limits in gear that holds up. Made from premium, high-strength recycled ocean fibers, this activewear delivers unmatched shape retention, moisture-wicking, and four-way stretch. Engineered specifically for athletes who train hard multiple days a week.
variants.rationale: This copy emphasizes high-performance technical fabric features like shape retention and moisture-wicking, appealing directly to her active, athlete-centric lifestyle.

bidStrategy.rationale: Mid-AOV product: pay per click at 1-2% of order value, a sustainable CPC if roughly 1 in 30 clicks converts

budget.rationale: $1500/publisher/month floor for statistically useful volume × 5 publishers × 1.25 premium-tier multiplier

assumptions: CPMs are heuristic estimates by audience income tier, not quoted rates
